title: 第965章 全盛之姿第694章 精微控气
slug: 性转狐狸开局就被抓走了
content_zh:
艾可追着梅，本打算凑上去打闹撕咬一番。
可就在这时，天穹骤然裂开一道缝隙，一股磅礴可怖的威压席卷了整个狐族村落。
“有人来袭击我们了？”艾可浑身止不住发颤，梅的状态也好不到哪里去。
“我早知晓她修为深不可测，却从未料到她能释放出这般镇压万物的气势。”梅眉头紧蹙，嘴角却又扬起一丝欣喜。
只要不出意外，他们这片领地便能安稳无忧。日后前往妖兽宗门，有黛露坐镇，他们手中的话语权也会重上许多。
“你是说，这股气息是黛露散发出来的？”艾可只觉得这威压早已不止可怖二字，那能量雄浑到近乎妖异。
“等你修成九尾，也能拥有这般气场。”梅轻笑一声。她早已体会过多尾狐妖的强大，可那滋味，终究无法与九尾相提并论。
五感极致升华，力量纯粹无匹，那种畅快，根本无法用言语形容！
“唉，也不知我还要修行多久……”世人计数方式不同，艾可如今算是四尾，也可算作八尾。
她实在难以想象，自己再多修出一条尾巴，便能释放出黛露此刻这般摄人心魄的气息。
二人缓步朝宗主峰走去，黛露此刻正在峰顶炼化那枚丹药。
忽然，一道熟悉的少女身影从旁边灌木丛里爬了出来：“没想到我直接被气浪掀飞出去了……”
“原来是你啊。”艾可眨了眨眼看向她。
“嗯嗯，我知道啦。”少女摆了摆手，打算随便找个地方躺平休息，等这股威压散去再说。
那群使团的人整日缠着她献殷勤，害得她数月没能好好睡一觉，如今总算能补个觉了！
再转头时，少女已然消失不见。艾可看着空荡荡的灌木丛，一时无言，这人犯困的速度未免也太快了。
“不必管她，趁现在我们去看看黛露。”梅笑着说道，她很想亲眼一睹九尾现世的异象，只是二人未必能扛住这铺天盖地的威压靠近峰顶。
“这难道是神魂层面的重压？”艾可歪了歪头，她的天赋术法【月壳】完全无法抵挡这股力量，想来这是直击心神的压制！
“差不多可以这么理解。”梅点了点头，虽不完全等同于神魂本身散出的压迫，但二者十分相近，这么说倒也不算错。
“天呐，我们该怎么靠近啊？”艾可摇了摇头，心中满是抵触，光是适应这股重压就要耗费她大量修为。

“或许我们只能在威压范围外扎营等候了。”梅皱起眉头，她虽遗憾错过九尾显化的奇观，但至少之后还有机会细细观摩、推演修行。
单凭这股磅礴气息就能判断，黛露的九尾近乎完美。若是能近距离观摩，对任何狐妖而言都是天大机缘。
这也是仙界狐族从不允许旁人触碰自己尾巴的缘由。
狐妖的修为底蕴、传承秘辛尽数藏于尾中，一旦被人窥探透彻，自身的弱点便会暴露无遗！
凡间世界修行体系尚浅，外人就算触碰也很难参透尾中奥秘，但梅还是打算把这件事讲给艾可听，防患于未然。
“不行，我一步都走不动了。”艾可察觉到双腿如同灌了铅，再也无法向前挪动半步，当即停下脚步。
“我们已经走到很远的地方了。”梅笑得眉眼弯弯。看来这一世她的修为，远比前世同期要强上许多。
虽说她掌握海量修行知识是根基，但修为差距之大，依旧超乎她的预料。
二者的鸿沟，堪比筑基修士直面元婴大能。
根本没有任何可比性！
“那我们就只能干等着？”艾可连走动都做不到，想离开都无能为力。
“这股威压并非针对我们二人，待在这里十分安全。”梅就地坐下，静静等候黛露完成丹药炼化。
“可这威压实在太折磨人了。”艾可小声抱怨。她本想找张软床消磨时间，可身体根本不听使唤。
艾可心中一动，暗中汇聚太阳本源之力，打算验证心中几个修行猜想。
灼热的气息自她体内迸发，身形骤然发生变化。
“嘿嘿，换我太阳艾可上场啦！”太阳形态的艾可蹦蹦跳跳，周遭可怖的威压竟完全无法撼动她分毫。
梅当场愣住，方才艾可还寸步难行，仅仅换了一重形态，周身散出灼热气息后，便能随意行动。
“你能不能别折腾了？”梅无奈叹气。
“没问题~”太阳艾可哼着小曲跑到梅身边。
她随手召出一张软床，直接将梅推躺上去。

“这下你能好好休息咯~”太阳艾可正要跳上床榻，半空身形一转，变回了常态的月之艾可。
“呼。”仅仅维持片刻太阳形态，艾可便消耗了海量太阳本源。
她暗自思索，要么是周遭环境的重压透支了力量，要么是太阳形态在主动抗衡威压，才会消耗如此剧烈。
但不管缘由如何，能躺在柔软床榻而非冰冷硬地上等候，艾可已经十分满足。
content_en:
Aike chased Mei, intending to fight and bite her.
But at this moment, a gap suddenly opened in the sky, and a majestic and terrifying pressure swept across the entire Fox Clan village.
"Is someone coming to attack us?" Aike couldn't stop trembling all over, and Mei's condition wasn't much better.
"I already knew that her cultivation was unfathomable, but I never expected that she could unleash such a power to suppress all things." Mei frowned, but the corner of her mouth raised a trace of joy.
As long as nothing happens, their territory will be safe and secure. When they go to the Monster Beast Sect in the future, with Dai Lu sitting in charge, they will have much more say in their hands.
"You mean, this aura is emanating from Dai Lu?" Ai Ke felt that the pressure was more than terrifying, and the energy was so powerful that it was almost monsterous.
"When you become Nine Tails, you will have such an aura." Mei chuckled. She has already experienced the power of the multi-tailed fox demon, but after all, the feeling cannot be compared with the nine-tailed one.
The five senses are extremely sublimated, the power is pure and unparalleled, and the feeling of pleasure cannot be described in words!
"Alas, I don't know how long I will continue to practice..." People in the world have different ways of counting. Ai Ke is now considered four tails, or eight tails.
It was hard for her to imagine that if she had just one more tail, she would be able to release Dai Lu's breathtaking aura.
The two walked slowly towards the sect's main peak, where Dai Lu was refining the elixir at the top.
Suddenly, a familiar figure of a girl crawled out from the bushes nearby: "I didn't expect that I was blown away by the air wave..."
"So it's you." Aike blinked and looked at her.
"Yeah, I know." The girl waved her hand and planned to find a place to lie down and rest until the pressure dissipated.
Those people from the mission were pestering her all day long to show their courtesy, which prevented her from having a good sleep for several months. Now she can finally catch up on her sleep!
When he turned around again, the girl had disappeared. Ai Ke looked at the empty bushes and was speechless for a moment. This man fell asleep too quickly.
"Don't worry about her, let's go see Dailu now." Mei said with a smile. She really wanted to see the vision of the Nine-Tails with her own eyes, but the two of them might not be able to withstand the overwhelming pressure and get close to the peak.
"Is this a heavy pressure on the level of the soul?" Ai Ke tilted her head. Her innate spell [Moon Shell] was completely unable to withstand this force. I think it was a suppression that hit the mind directly!
"It can be understood that way." Mei nodded. Although it is not completely equivalent to the oppression radiated by the soul itself, the two are very similar, so it is not wrong to say so.
"Oh my god, how should we get closer?" Ai Ke shook her head, her heart full of resistance. Just adapting to this pressure would cost her a lot of cultivation.
"Perhaps we can only camp outside the coercion range and wait." Mei frowned. Although she regretted missing the spectacle of the Nine-Tails manifesting, at least she would have the opportunity to observe and practice in detail.
Judging from this majestic aura alone, Dailu's Nine Tails is almost perfect. It would be a great opportunity for any fox demon to be able to observe it up close.
This is also the reason why the fox tribe in the fairy world never allows others to touch their tails.
The fox demon's cultivation base and inheritance secrets are all hidden in its tail. Once someone peeps into it, its own weaknesses will be exposed!
The cultivation system in the mortal world is still shallow, and it is difficult for outsiders to understand the secrets of Wei even if they touch it, but Mei still plans to tell Ai Ke about it to nip it in the bud.
"No, I can't walk even one step." Ai Ke realized that his legs were filled with lead, and he could no longer move even half a step forward, so he stopped immediately.
"We have gone very far." Mei smiled with her eyebrows creasing. It seems that her cultivation in this life is much stronger than the same period in her previous life.
Although she had mastered a vast amount of cultivation knowledge as her foundation, the huge gap in cultivation was still beyond her expectation.
The gap between the two is comparable to that of a foundation-building monkFace the power of Nascent Soul.
There is no comparison at all!
"Then we can only wait?" Ai Ke couldn't even move around, and couldn't do anything to leave.
"This pressure is not directed at the two of us. It is very safe to stay here." Mei sat down on the spot and waited quietly for Dailu to finish refining the elixir.
"But this pressure is too torturous." Aike complained softly. She originally wanted to find a soft bed to kill time, but her body didn't obey her at all.
Ai Ke's heart moved, and he secretly gathered the power of the sun's origin, intending to verify several cultivation conjectures in his mind.
Hot breath burst out from her body, and her body shape suddenly changed.
"Hey, it's my turn to play Sun Aike!" Aike jumped up and down in the form of the sun, but the terrifying pressure around her couldn't shake her at all.
Mei was stunned on the spot. Ai Ke was still unable to move even a moment ago. He just changed his form, and after the burning aura emitted from his body, he was able to move at will.
"Can you stop bothering me?" Mei sighed helplessly.
"No problem~" Taiyang Aiko hummed a tune and ran to Mei.
She summoned a soft bed and directly pushed Mei to lie down on it.
"Now you can have a good rest~" Sun Echo was about to jump on the bed, but she turned around in mid-air and turned back to her normal Moon Echo.
"Huh." Just maintaining the sun's form for a moment, Ai Ke consumed a massive amount of the sun's source.
She secretly thought that either the pressure of the surrounding environment had overdrawn her strength, or the form of the sun was actively resisting the pressure, which was why it was so intensely consumed.
But no matter what the reason was, Ai Ke was very satisfied to be able to lie on a soft bed instead of waiting on the cold hard ground.
